text: DSH Article Review 是一款面向 DSH Web 与桌面端的学术稿件审阅插件：它在会话侧栏提供稿件工作台，并注册读取、批注、修改提案和决定等工具。用户可打开工作区中的 Markdown 文稿，查看逐段内容，记录批注，让 agent 提交可审阅的文本或图表修改，再逐项接受或拒绝并查看差异；还可浏览 BibTeX 引用、管理图表，并使用论文项目工具整理论点、证据和段落草稿。适合需要在本地工作区协作审阅论文的作者；需要 DSH 会话及其已配置的模型，不要求额外 API key。

DSH Article Review adds manuscript reading and review tools to DSH. Open Markdown papers, annotate passages, inspect proposed edits, and accept or reject changes. It also supports BibTeX references, figure replacement, and paper project notes. Uses your configured DSH model.

怎样给稿件选中文字加批注，再把批注交给 agent 参考？
有没有办法比较论文修改前后的文字，并标出具体变化？
我想检查论文里的 BibTeX 引用并绑定正确的文献库。
I want to review an AI’s manuscript edits one proposal at a time before applying them.
Can I browse cited BibTeX entries and replace a figure from my workspace?
DSH Article Review 的功能「annotations」：在稿件中选择段落并保存作者批注，工具可读取批注及其对应的精确引文；批注可附到会话中供 agent 参考。
DSH Article Review 的功能「proposal-review」：agent 可为稿件提出文本修改，作者可检查、修订并接受或拒绝提案；接受的变更更新 Markdown，并可查看字词级差异。
DSH Article Review 的功能「bibliography」：浏览工作区中的 BibTeX 文件和条目，绑定稿件使用的文献库，并查询或维护引用记录。
DSH Article Review 的功能「figures」：列出稿件引用的本地图像并提出图表替换；替换内容作为待审提案呈现，作者接受前不改稿件。
DSH Article Review 的功能「paper-project」：项目工具将稿件论点、证据、评论和段落草稿组织成项目，可读取项目内容、记录评论并创建或应用草稿。

如何把现有稿件的论点、证据和评论整理成可继续编辑的论文项目？

dsh-article-review README · DSH Article Review：English | [中文](README.zh.md)

A plugin for academic writing in [DSH (DeepSeek Harness)](https://github.com/deepseek-ai/deepseek-harness), the AI agent app that runs on your own computer as a Desktop app or in the browser; install DSH first by following [its README](https://github.com/deepseek-ai/deepseek-harness#readme). The plugin adds a panel beside your DSH conversation where you and the AI work on a paper: you read and annotate, the AI proposes changes, and you decide what is accepted.

dsh-article-review README · DSH Article Review：**Your data:** manuscripts and review records stay in the conversation's workspace folder on your computer. Manuscript text is sent only to the model you configured in DSH. If you enable automatic plugin updates, the updater contacts npm for version metadata and package downloads; it does not upload manuscripts or review records. If unpublished work must not leave your computer, configure a local model in DSH.

*Screenshots use fictional manuscripts; proposals include real model runs.*

dsh-article-review README · Automatic updates：After installing **1.0.3**, open **Paper → 插件更新** and enable **自动更新文章审阅插件** once. It is off by default. The independent helper checks at startup and every six hours, downloads only a newer npm release compatible with the installed DSH, verifies its SHA-512 checksum, waits for DSH to exit, and activates it on the next launch. Manuscripts, review records, sessions and model settings stay in place.

dsh-article-review README · Automatic updates：Supported schedulers: Windows current-user Task Scheduler (no elevation), macOS LaunchAgent, and Linux user systemd. The account must be logged in / have its user service running, and the captured Node/DSH runtime and npm network access must remain available. Turning the setting off removes the scheduled job. Existing users need to install this release once before the switch becomes available.

dsh-article-review README · What you can do：- **You open** one Markdown manuscript. PDF, Word and LaTeX are converted to a Markdown copy first.
- **You use it to** annotate, ask the AI for edits, accept or reject word-level changes, and track what you have reviewed.
- **You get back** the Markdown file, edited where you accepted changes. There is no export to Word or LaTeX: carry accepted changes into your original yourself.
- **Needs** any model you use in DSH. Interface in English or Chinese.

dsh-article-review README · What you can do：- **You open** a paper you already have (PDF, Word, LaTeX or Markdown); the agent builds a project from it.
- **You use it to** see the argument as a map (the main claim, the storyline section by section, the claims under it, and the evidence and figure panels behind each), get comments from simulated editors, reviewers and readers, and read with figures beside the text.
- **You get back** a project folder with the map, comments and rewrite drafts. Your original files are never changed, and nothing is exported back to Word or LaTeX.
- **Needs** a model that can read images; time and model usage grow with length (a 4-page paper took about 12 minutes, a 45-page paper about an hour). Interface in Chinese.

dsh-article-review README · Install：**Requirements:** DSH Desktop (`0.2.0-rc.2` to `0.2.2-alpha.2`, including `0.2.1-rc.5`; runtime included) or DSH Web (`0.2.1-alpha.4`; DSH `0.2.2-alpha.2` on the web needs Node.js 24.9+). To import PDF, Word or LaTeX, install [`uv`](https://docs.astral.sh/uv/getting-started/installation/) once yourself; on first use it downloads Python with the PyMuPDF, Pandoc and Pillow packages (about 100 MB) into the workspace's `.paper-tools/` folder, so that first import needs network access. Nothing is installed into your system Python. The plugin uses your existing model configuration.

dsh-article-review README · Install：**Desktop app**

1. Open **Plugins** in the app's left sidebar and click **Add plugin**.
2. Paste the package name `dsh-article-review`.
3. Click **Enable now** and follow any restart prompt.
4. Open a conversation in a local workspace (a folder on your computer) and choose the panel in the right sidebar.

**Web**

```sh
dsh plugin --profile web add dsh-article-review
dsh web
```

Restart a running Web profile after installation.

dsh-article-review README · Install：- **Today's release:** the registry's `latest` tag points to `1.0.3`. pnpm 11 waits 24 hours before installing a new release by its bare name; to install it today, use `dsh-article-review@1.0.3` or the [package-only opt-in](docs/installation-channels.md).
- **Mirror or GitHub:** you can use the official npm registry or the mainland China mirror (switch back to the official registry if the mirror has not synced). GitHub installation is `github:Biogod2020/dsh-article-review#v1.0.3`. If GitHub times out, download the [prebuilt release archive](https://codeload.github.com/Biogod2020/dsh-article-review/tar.gz/refs/tags/v1.0.3) and enter its absolute local path in **Plugins → Add plugin**, without extracting or building it. Use a prebuilt tag; `main` contains development source.
- **Desktop and Web are separate:** Desktop uses its own `desktop` profile, so installing into `web` does not install into the app.

dsh-article-review README · Manuscript review：1. Choose **Read, annotate and revise** in the right sidebar and open a Markdown manuscript from the workspace (on Desktop, **Browse workspace → Choose local file** opens the system file dialog; the file must be inside the conversation's workspace). To start from a PDF, Word, LaTeX or pasted text, choose **Import article** in the reader's file controls, or type the import command `/paper-project-start` in the conversation (despite its name, it only imports the article for manuscript review and does not create a paper project); the converted Markdown copy opens in the reader and your original is kept.
2. Select text, annotate it, attach the notes to the conversation and send your request.
3. In **Review changes**, accept, reject or request a revision of each proposal; check the result and mark it reviewed.

dsh-article-review README · Manuscript review：Accepting a proposal updates the Markdown file. Each paragraph stays compared with **the last version you marked reviewed**, so later changes stand out. Review records live in `.paper-review/` next to the manuscript: back it up with the manuscript and keep it out of public Git history. See the [user guide](docs/user-guide.md) for figures, references and versions.

dsh-article-review README · Paper projects (next release)：Paper projects are on `main` and will be in the next npm release; the current release does not include them. The project panel's interface is in Chinese.

Choose **Paper** (论文) in the right sidebar and start from a paper you already have:

dsh-article-review README · Paper projects (next release)：1. Enter the manuscript, and optionally its figure folder, existing comments and the research repository it comes from. The panel proposes a project folder inside the workspace and checks every path before starting.
2. Choose **交给 agent 初始化** (Hand to agent). The agent reads the paper page by page and copies the text into the project, cuts out each figure and its panels (the lettered parts a, b, c) by looking at the page, maps the argument, and finally checks its copy against your file and fixes what it missed. It runs as tasks in the current DSH conversation: the panel shows progress and can pause, resume or stop, and typing in that conversation pauses it.
3. Work in the project:
   - **Story map (故事流):** the main claim, the storyline section by section, and the claims under it, each with the evidence and figure panels behind it. Mark items reviewed; later changes are flagged.
   - **Read (阅读):** the text in pages, with the figure panels each page cites beside it.
